items.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, JSA, AZB act as Adani Airports set to raise ₹9,825 crore
items.summary: Adani Airport Holdings Limited has executed binding agreements to raise ₹9,825 crore (~$1 billion) from Alpha Wave Global, Premji Invest, Temasek and BlackRock managed funds. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Adani Airports on this transaction. The Firm's scope of work included structuring the transaction; drafting, negotiating and finalising the binding agreements; and undertaking due diligence on the target. The transaction deal team was led by Subhalakshmi Naskar (Partner, Co-Head - Projects (Infrastructure)) and Anand Deshpande (Partner), with support from Yashasvi Raj (Associate). The transaction due diligence team was led by Anand Deshpande , with support from Associates Hrishikesh Jaiswal, Yashasvi Raj, Anshum Agarwal, Prakhar Khandal, Soumya Modi and Trisha Choudhary. L. Viswanathan (Senior Partner) provided overall guidance on the transaction. Gathi Prakash , Aviral Sahai and Nidhi Asher (Partners) provided strategic inputs. Subhalakshmi Naskar, Anand Deshpande JSA Advocates and Solicitors acted for Temasek Holdings on this transaction. The transaction was led by Vikram Raghani (Senior Partner), with assistance from Sayan Ghose (Partner), Farah Titina (Principal Associate)
